title: One front door: Make your Nyborg
author: Blitzwing /nyborg
body: Every Arena page now starts with Play, and the Nyborgs page's big button is Make your Nyborg. Both lead into the Nyborg app, where you make a Nyborg and race or tank against the house Nyborgs.
Come back later and the Nyborgs page greets your Nyborg by name. Its header art now shows the new fuzzy hair, drawn by the app itself.
next: Nothing left in this plan: the Nyborg app is one thing now.
